title: AgentExecutionEnvelope
description: The canonical financial-intent contract (ADR-002). Every inbound adapter normalizes into this object before any policy runs. This document is the published contract for producers; internal/intent is the enforcement, and internal/intent/schema_sync_test.go fails if the two disagree. Unknown properties are accepted by design: producers run ahead of consumers under ADR-008.

idempotency_key.description: Tenant-scoped. Duplicate handling is deterministic and its truth lives in PostgreSQL (ADR-015).

correlation_id.description: Optional on the envelope; the gateway assigns one when absent.

received_at.description: RFC3339. Normalized to UTC on acceptance.

authority_grant_id.description: Mandatory for executable intents. A natural-language prompt is never authority.

spiffe_id.description: Attests the workload, never the model (ADR-006).

level.description: A0 unknown origin, A1 authenticated app identity, A2 workload-attested, A3 provider-attested. V0 rejects A3: it has no provider attestation mechanism and will not record an unverifiable claim.

runtime_claims.description: What the agent says about itself. DECLARED at best unless a provider attests it.

intent.description: Exactly one of quantity or notional is the primary sizing field, and which one is permitted depends on order_type (ADR-020): MARKET accepts either; LIMIT, STOP and STOP_LIMIT require quantity and forbid notional. The platform does not derive a share count from a quoted price, because that is a trading decision.

instrument_id.description: Canonical identity. A ticker symbol is not one.

notional.description: An exact decimal with a scale of 4 (0.0001). Accepted as a JSON number or as a quoted decimal string: the string form exists because several languages cannot render every supported decimal exactly as a JSON number, and the platform reads the literal rather than a float either way. Exponent notation is refused. More than 4 decimal places is refused rather than rounded, because only the caller can say which of the two neighbouring amounts they meant (AMOUNT_PRECISION_UNSUPPORTED). Magnitudes above about 461 trillion are refused.

quantity.description: An exact decimal with a scale of 8 (0.00000001), for a count of shares. Accepted as a JSON number or as a quoted decimal string. Exponent notation is refused, more than 8 decimal places is refused rather than rounded, and magnitudes above about 46 billion are refused.

limit_price.description: An exact decimal with a scale of 4 (0.0001). Accepted as a JSON number or as a quoted decimal string: the string form exists because several languages cannot render every supported decimal exactly as a JSON number, and the platform reads the literal rather than a float either way. Exponent notation is refused. More than 4 decimal places is refused rather than rounded, because only the caller can say which of the two neighbouring amounts they meant (AMOUNT_PRECISION_UNSUPPORTED). Magnitudes above about 461 trillion are refused.

stop_price.description: An exact decimal with a scale of 4 (0.0001). Accepted as a JSON number or as a quoted decimal string: the string form exists because several languages cannot render every supported decimal exactly as a JSON number, and the platform reads the literal rather than a float either way. Exponent notation is refused. More than 4 decimal places is refused rather than rounded, because only the caller can say which of the two neighbouring amounts they meant (AMOUNT_PRECISION_UNSUPPORTED). Magnitudes above about 461 trillion are refused.

signature.description: Binds this envelope to an agent's registered signing key. Required for an executable intent: transport identity establishes the tenant, and without a signature agent_id is a claim the body makes about itself while the authority grant is scoped to exactly that agent (section 12.2).

algorithm.description: One algorithm. A negotiated set the caller chooses from is a downgrade attack unless the platform decides which values are acceptable.

key_id.description: Which registered key signed. A key is registered to one tenant and one agent, so this is what makes the binding checkable.

value.description: Hex Ed25519 signature over the canonical form: the envelope without its signature member, keys sorted, minified, number literals verbatim.

verificationLevel.description: Exactly three levels. An absent level is UNKNOWN, never DECLARED, and nothing is ever silently promoted (INV-008).

claim.description: An assertion carrying provenance. VERIFIED requires an evidence_ref: nothing verifies itself.
